handler_contract_probe.method: read apps/agent-core/src/paint_handlers.rs against the measured real tree and compare with the fake platform in apps/agent-core/tests/production_paint.rs

findings.handler_contract: read_text(button) must equal the English tool id, e.g. `rectangle`
findings.real_paint: the rectangle GridViewItem exposes the localized Name `矩形` and has no AutomationId
findings.verdict: the read-back can never equal `rectangle` on a zh-CN Paint

findings.real_paint: the foreground control is a RadioButton named `颜色 1: 黑色`; Paint exposes no settable value for it
findings.verdict: set_value plus RGB read-back is unsupported by the real control

findings.handler_contract: select(ListViewItem, ByStableValue(layer_id)) then read_text must equal `Layer 1`
findings.real_paint: the layers panel is collapsed and exposes no ListViewItem; the tree has no ListView/ListItem at all
findings.verdict: the target element does not exist in the default Paint state

findings.handler_contract: resolve `status_bar` and parse two integers from its text
findings.real_paint: no StatusBar-role element exists; the canvas size lives in TextBlock aid=CanvasSizeTextBlock as `418 × 74像素`
findings.verdict: the selector must point at CanvasSizeTextBlock; the integer parse itself would work

handler_contract_probe.conclusion: TASK-106's Paint handlers were validated only against a fake platform that mirrors the handler's own expectations. Selector calibration alone cannot make T3.1 run: the tool/color/layer read-back contracts and the shape/color gallery anchors need a design decision (localized fallback versus another anchor, palette click versus the color dialog, collapsed layers panel).

real_contract_calibration.method: temporary Rust UIA probe under target/paint_probe (not committed), including toggling the Paint layers panel and sampling the measured palette rectangles

shape_gallery.selection_contract: SelectionItemPattern::Select must report IsSelected=true for the selected GridViewItem

color_gallery.selection_contract: Select the measured child index; the platform verifies SelectionItemPattern::IsSelected

layers.selection_contract: Expand the panel, select the measured first child by index, and verify SelectionItemPattern::IsSelected; restore the collapsed state after selection

handler_resolution.paint.tool.select: Resolve the shape GridView under the localized 形状 scope and select measured child index 3; do not compare localized item text.
handler_resolution.paint.color.select_foreground: Resolve the color GridView under the localized 颜色 scope and select the measured RGB-to-index mapping; unsupported RGB fails explicitly.
handler_resolution.paint.layer.select: Expand the measured layers panel when needed, select measured child index 0, then restore the collapsed state.
handler_resolution.paint.document.new: Resolve status_bar to CanvasSizeTextBlock and parse the existing integer text.

real_contract_calibration.conclusion: TASK-256 calibrates the T3.1 selector and handler contracts without changing platform traits or schemas; the remaining real-GUI acceptance measurements stay in TASK-044.

keytip_and_palette_probe.method: throwaway probe under target/paint_keytip (not committed): read the UIA AccessKey property of every element, press Alt + KeyTip letters via keybd_event, and cross-check the fixed palette against a published source

shape_gallery.conclusion: No KeyTip for the shapes gallery and no keyboard-focusable shape item; L2 keyboard selection of a shape tool is impossible on this build.

color_gallery.palette_hex_order: aligned to the measured palette index order (0..19), not the source page order
color_gallery.conclusion: No per-swatch KeyTip; the fixed palette is a known RGB set, so fixed or arbitrary colors can go through the Edit Colors dialog instead of swatch selection.

edit_colors_dialog.conclusion: Arbitrary RGB has a stable-aid path; write HexTextBox or the three channel edits.

layers_panel.conclusion: Alt+L toggles the layers panel without resolving the localized toggle button.

selector_gap.shape_container: Group name 形状, no AutomationId, no distinguishing ClassName; NameRegex is a UIA substring match so 形状 also hits 形状轮廓 / 形状填充
selector_gap.color_container: Group name 颜色, no AutomationId, no distinguishing ClassName
selector_gap.required_capability: exact Name equality candidate (ADR-0086) to disambiguate the container without a regex engine
